behaviors.behavior: Build the Docker image from the provided Dockerfile to set up the 2080Ti environment, or from image/Dockerfile.a100 for the A100 environment.
behaviors.precondition: Docker available; CUDA driver larger than 11.2; target GPU is NVIDIA 2080Ti or A100.

evidence.quote: Please use docker to build the image/Dockerﬁle to set up the environment for 2080Ti and image/Dockerﬁle.a100 to set up the environment for A100.

behaviors.behavior: Start a Docker instance with GPU access and 16G shared memory from the built artifact image.
behaviors.precondition: Docker image built; Docker available with GPU support.

behaviors.behavior: Install SparTA into the Python environment via 'python setup.py develop' after activating the artifact conda environment.
behaviors.precondition: Docker instance started; source code checked out; conda environment 'artifact' exists.

behaviors.behavior: Run init_env.sh to initialize environment variables and download the datasets.
behaviors.precondition: SparTA installed in the Python environment; executed from the script directory.

evidence.quote: run the init_env.sh to initialize the environment variables and download the datasets.

behaviors.behavior: Run per-figure shell scripts to reproduce and visualize each experiment's results automatically.
behaviors.precondition: Environment initialized; each figure (8-11, 14-18, 20) has its own shell script.
search_terms: Each ﬁgure has a shell script

evidence.quote: Each ﬁgure has a shell script to reproduce and visualize the experimental results automatically.

behaviors.behavior: Run all experiments with one command via run_all_2080ti.sh on 2080Ti or run_all_a100.sh on A100.
behaviors.precondition: Executed from the script directory; target GPU matches the chosen script.

changes.reason: 该行为将“启动 Docker 实例”与“在 Python 环境中安装 SparTA”两个可独立验证的动作合并，且证据仅引用 docker run 命令，未直接引用 setup.py develop 的原文；应拆分为两个原子行为。
